scientific_integrity: Exact integer and rational computations; source materials separated from new integral invariants; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Arithmetic cone and trace indices are computed using standard degree-five del Pezzo/Weyl classification; prior papers already give the seven Galois cycle types and Picard ranks. Completeness of priority review is not guaranteed, including possible equivalent tabulations. Cone membership does not assert integral effectivity for every lattice point.
title: Integral Frobenius trace lattices and arithmetic cones of degree-five del Pezzo surfaces
